summary: 80-foot Aermotor LS40 tower on Colfax Mountain, Washington County, NY; ceased lookout use in 1970 and now a fenced NYSDEC radio site.

facts.agency: New York State Department of Environmental Conservation

access.note: Closed to the public since 1970 and surrounded by fencing; it carries radio repeater equipment for NYSDEC.

visit.trail_note: Fenced radio site, closed to the public.

events.note: NHLR build year; a Times Record piece from April 1951 still describes the tower as being built
Ernest L. Bennett's roster service begins April 1951; he is named as observer in April 1951
Jennie B. Bennett is the last observer on the roster, serving through November 1970
Closed to the public (NHLR); ceased operations as a lookout (roster)
Registered December 23, 2022 as US 1700, NY 52; nominated by Laurie Rankin

notes_for_editor: Build year: NHLR says 1950; the October 1950 Post-Star report says the tower had just shipped and was in temporary storage; the April 1951 Times Record says it was being built. The story reports this rather than choosing; the NHLR 1950 date is kept in events. Height: 80 ft (NHLR and 1950 report) vs 81 ft (1951 paper). The record's height_m 24.4 matches 80 ft and is left unchanged; the sources do not say whether the height is to the cab floor. Status label: the FFLA New York list shows this site with status 'Private' rather than 'Standing'; NHLR describes it as still standing and in NYSDEC use, so the record's 'standing' is kept, but a human should check the FFLA label. Observer names come from a state roster and a 1951 paper; no residences are given. The private property where the tower was stored in 1950 is not named. Radio users: the roster says 'several agencies'; the story uses NHLR for today's NYSDEC use. No corrections proposed.
